ds: Import Excel now reads your Drillhole register sheet (PDHID, HoleID, LocationX/Y/Z planned and actual, Azimuth, Dip, PlanDepth, DrillStarted, DrillComplete, Status, RigTyp, RigNo, RigLocation, SupGeo, Remarks). Holes already in the app get their plan ID, target depth, azimuth, dip, collar coordinates, start and complete dates, status, rig, area, geologist and remarks updated; the plan holes list is updated and a plan hole whose ID differs (for example 415 for UGP-17) is renamed when azimuth, dip and depth match. A list of every change is shown, and Undo takes the hole changes back. The register looks the same as before.
